title: Something downstairs has your name in a ledger
dek: No summoning circles, no Latin. Twelve ordinary questions, and whichever old demon has been keeping your file steps forward.

questions.prompt: The entry beside your name is written in:

options.label: Gold ink, and it is a little showy
A hand that has not slept in weeks
Something that still smells like the kitchen
A correction, on top of a correction

questions.prompt: At the crossroads, you would trade for:

options.label: Your name, in a very good light
Ten years and an extremely comfortable chair
The thing you have never told anyone
One clean, enormous favour
A whisper exactly one inch behind your ear
The floorboards first, then the ceiling
Candles, two glasses, one chair too many
options.alt: Candles burning on a set dinner table

options.label: A library where the ladder has been moved
options.alt: A tall bookshelf with a wooden ladder

options.label: A corridor with one door at the end
options.alt: A dark, narrow hallway leading to a closed door

options.label: A boardroom with the blinds half down
options.alt: An empty corporate boardroom with a long table

questions.helper: Across: whisper or shove. Up: hunger or vanity.
First place is the thing you would sign for tonight.
Two gaps. Read it twice before you sign.
questions.template: The contract promises {a}, in exchange for {b}.

options.label: that you will be admired
that you will never want for anything
that nobody will ever know
one more year of peace and quiet
a small, permanent piece of your attention
the first thing you ever really wanted
every door in the house, unlocked
a promise you will make in your sleep

questions.prompt: I would rather be envied than liked.
questions.low: I want people to like me
questions.high: Let them look, then let them count

questions.prompt: Doing nothing is its own kind of luxury.
You can want something without needing anyone to see you have it.

options.label: Arrive early, look incredible, say very little
Know the one thing you were not supposed to know
Take the entire shelf and apologize later
Let the silence do the work
Quote you wrong at parties
Count what they lost
Dream about the same corridor
Feel watched, and not entirely mind

results.name: THE MORNING STAR
results.tagline: You did not fall, you made an entrance
results.blurb: You are not interested in being liked. You are interested in being the reason a room changes when you walk into it, and you usually are. Your confidence is a load-bearing wall: everyone leans on it, nobody asks whether it was ever inspected.
strengths: Sets the tone in any room
results.watchOut: The performance is not the point. Take the armour off for the people who stayed.

results.name: THE LEDGER KEEPER
results.blurb: You know what everything costs, including favours. You keep a running total of who owes who and you are rarely wrong about it, which makes you very good in a crisis and slightly exhausting at dinner. You have never once been short of a favour to call in.
strengths: Remembers every kindness and every debt
results.watchOut: Not every relationship is a balance sheet. Some things are free and should stay that way.

results.name: THE ONE IN THE CANDLELIGHT
results.tagline: You have a way of being looked at
results.blurb: You understand desire as a language and you speak it fluently, even when you are being domestic about it. People tell you things at 2am they have never told anyone. You collect them gently, and you would never use them. Probably.
results.watchOut: Being wanted is not the same as being known. Let someone stay past the interesting part.

results.name: THE LORD OF THE FEAST
results.tagline: There is always room for one more plate
results.blurb: Your file is a list of everything you have ever craved, and it is not a short list. You are generous with it: the table is full, the door is open, the fridge is a public institution. Appetite, for you, is just another word for being alive.
strengths: Makes a table feel like an event
results.watchOut: More is not always better, and the cupboard is not infinite. Leave something for tomorrow.

results.name: THE THING IN DEEP WATER
results.blurb: You have never announced a rivalry. You have simply kept a very detailed internal record, and eventually the water rises. You are patient the way something enormous at the bottom of the sea is patient, and when you finally move, everyone notices the wake.
results.watchOut: The scoreboard is in your head and it never clears. Say what you want out loud.

results.name: THE ONE ON THE COMFORTABLE CHAIR
results.tagline: You'll get to it, and it will be fine
results.blurb: You know something the rest of them don't: most urgency is invented. You do nothing on purpose, at length, and the world keeps turning. Then, in the last possible hour, you produce something unusually good, which is deeply irritating to everyone who started on time.
results.watchOut: Sometimes the deadline is real. Sometimes the person waiting is real too.

results.name: THE ONE WHO TAKES IT APART
results.tagline: You didn't break it. You finished it
results.blurb: You are drawn to the ending of things: the last scene, the ruin, the honest collapse. You are not cruel. You are just clear-eyed about the fact that some things need to be taken apart so anything can be built in their place. Very little intimidates you, which is either a gift or a problem.
strengths: Sees the rot nobody admits to
results.watchOut: Not everything is a demolition. Some things just need repair, patience and a second look.

results.name: THE ONE ON THE WIND
results.blurb: You show up as a change in air pressure: a headache, a strange dream, a week that will not behave. You do not mean harm. You are simply a force that passes through, and the rooms you pass through remember you for years.
results.watchOut: You leave a mess without noticing. Circle back and apologise.

results.name: THE KEEPER OF THE UNCOMFORTABLE FACT
results.tagline: You know the thing. You've always known the thing
results.blurb: You read the fine print, the footnotes and the part everybody skipped, and you remember all of it. You are the most useful person at any gathering and the least relaxing. Knowledge is your bargain with the world, and the world has never once come out ahead on it.
strengths: Sees the trick before it lands
results.watchOut: Not every truth improves the evening. Learn when to close the book.

results.name: THE ONE IN THE FINE PRINT
results.tagline: Nothing is a lie if you choose your words well
results.blurb: You are not dishonest. You are precise, and precision is its own kind of trap. You phrase things so beautifully that people agree before they understand, and you do it accidentally as often as on purpose. The contract is always valid. That is the whole problem.
results.watchOut: You can be technically right and still the cause of the whole mess. Say the plain version.
